I've graded s1 for quiz 0001 and written all the files. You got 2 correct, 2 partial and 2 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Why |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | The loop is what makes it an agent. |
| q2 | wrong (M4) | You picked the option where the model opens the booking system itself. The model only outputs a request naming `check_calendar` with its arguments. |
| q3 | correct | A step limit is the right safeguard. |
| q4 | wrong (M4) | The answer is 4, not 1. The model doesn't run the tools: each tool result triggers another model call, so it's 3 + 1. |
| q5 | partial | You said the result goes back to the model but not why: so it can choose its next step or write the final answer. |
| q6 | partial (M3) | You were right that the model picks tools from their descriptions. You were wrong that it remembers earlier sessions on its own. The program has to put any memory back into its input. |

The one thing to work on is who does what: the model writes a request, and the program runs the tool and calls the model again. That idea cost you q2, q4 and part of q6.

**Next step:** Reread the Anthropic docs page "Tool use with Claude" (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/overview). Then redraw your Friday laser-cutter trace in two columns, model and program, marking which one does each step.

- **Section pointers:** The workspace had no lessons, cheat sheets or sources. I added that Anthropic page to `RESOURCES.md` after one web search. I only saw its title and URL, so the feedback points to the page as a whole, not to named sections.
